name: pharos-dapp-support-agent
description: Explains why a Pharos transaction failed: fetches it through the Pharos Chain MCP, decodes the revert, and says what to do about it.

scripts.test: node test/index.test.mjs && node test/chain-mcp.test.mjs && node test/api.test.mjs && node scripts/gen-skill-table.mjs --check
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name pharos-dapp-support-agent
scripts.sync:public: cp src/diagnostics.mjs public/diagnostics.mjs && cp src/chain-mcp.mjs public/chain-mcp.mjs
